## 4.1.29 (HexGhoul): Arima, phase 2 part 2: the golden case and his heavy blade

HexKagune 4.1.29 for Forge 1.20.1. Not tested in game. Previews: `docs/handoff/arima-case-draw-4.1.29.png` (the case, front, three-quarter,
side), `docs/handoff/arima-blade-string-4.1.29.png` (his string, front, side, three-quarter, above), `docs/handoff/arima-blade-4.1.29.png`
(the blade alone).

Your words: "this phase should trigger when he reaches about 90 HP, in which case he becomes immortal, takes the jacket off, pulls out a
random briefcase from his back like a golden looking briefcase, um and then he becomes, well, this with the weapon." Of the first try at the
case: "Why can't the blade just, like the briefcase just splits apart open like a normal fucking briefcase and releases the weapon?" And:
"Do not make the last quinque of Arima droppable. It's not needed. Just keep it only for himself."

**What it was (4.1.28):** at half health he took his jacket off and went back to Dawn.

**Now:**
- **90 HP** (of his 280) starts it, not half. With the jacket on, no blow takes him below 90, however big; nothing lands on him through the
  whole change. `/kill` still kills him.
- **The jacket comes off** (as 4.1.28), then **the golden case**: his right hand goes behind his back and comes out with a gold briefcase,
  he swings it out and lifts it in front of him, it **splits open on its hinge** (red lining inside), **the blade slides out of it** into
  his hands, and the empty case drops at his feet and sinks away.
- **His blade:** a long straight silver blade cracked with red veins, the organic silver guard with its red gems and spines, the long grip
  with the ring, the horn and the red-tipped rod, from your two pictures. Smooth, not blocky. His alone: no item, never dropped.
- **His heavy string, both hands on the grip in front of him:** an overhead cleave, a rising cut, a sweep across, then a thrust with all his
  weight. Each blow hits everything in its arc for heavy damage (the thrust the hardest), throws it back, and leaves **2 stacks of the mod's
  bleeding** (the same drips and pools as Ukaku's) on every hit. He chains the next blow while you're in reach and closes in at a run.
- **No Dawn** in this phase: no lightning, no soar, no ground strike. Dawn's case still drops when he dies (as 4.1.23).

**Next for Arima:** close combat only (precise dashes, dodging what you throw), then the end (the blade shatters, he falls to his knees).
